epistemic_status: DESIGN OR IMPLEMENTATION ANALYSIS of a documented prospective-capture defect. Isolated branch only. This lane does not block possession research unless it changes the historical feature evidence.
documented_defect_text: Lead-window execution latency. Two records created 22:45:08Z against 22:34 / 22:44 cutoffs. Distinct from D-b: discovery worked, execution was late.

late_records.note: on time by 14.85 min against the tip known at write; classified late only because the tip was revised -16 min afterwards

findings.title: The documented mechanism is wrong: the gate declined; an ungated second scheduled task wrote the records
findings.claim: should_run_base.py evaluated at 2026-08-03T22:45:06.515064Z and returned fire=False; run_pair.cmd took the else branch and did not invoke daily_forecast.py. The two records were written 2.44 s later at 22:45:08.958486Z by scheduled task WNBA_DailyForecast_PM (python daily_forecast.py --live, Daily 6:45:00 PM, no repetition, last run 2026-08-03 6:45:01 PM ET = 22:45:01Z), which never calls the gate.
evidence: forecasts/runner_logs/pair_20260803.log:872-874 (arm runner read 19 base records at 22:45:08.859Z, 0.1 s before records 19-21 existed)
prospective_pair/run_pair.cmd (gated base step; else branch prints '[base] skipped')
findings.consequence: The remediation assigned at PROJECT_UPDATE_2026-08-04.md:611 (amend should_run_base.py) cannot fix D-d. The writer does not import, invoke or depend on that file.

findings.title: The official chain has no late-write refusal; the challenger chain has two
findings.claim: prospective_pair/alt_model_log.py refuses any arm forecast created after its own cutoff, and run_prospective.py declines with late_prevented. No equivalent rule exists anywhere on the official base chain, which is why every late record in the repository is a base record.

findings.title: Retroactive relabelling: a later tip revision converted an on-time record into a late_record
findings.claim: coverage_audit.py computes the cutoff from the LATEST captured tip. At write time (22:45:08Z) the newest capture asserted ATL v LVA tip 23:30 (T-30m cutoff 23:00), making the record 14.85 min EARLY. Captures at 23:00:02Z and 00:00:02Z revised the tip to 23:00 then 23:14, producing cutoff 22:44 and a +1.15 min late_record. NYL v SEA moved 23:00 -> 23:05 -> 23:04 and is late on both clocks.
evidence: prospective_pair/coverage_audit.py:75 (TIP_MOVE_TOLERANCE = 30 min, so a 16-min move is not flagged)

findings.title: D-a's corrected operational-miss figure depends on which lateness clock the auditor uses
findings.claim: 2026-08-03 CHI v PHX T-30m is classified missing_data_unavailable with reason 'job served 2 other game(s) on 2026-08-03 at T-30m'; those two are exactly records 19 and 20. D-a proposes excluding late records from served-evidence, giving operational misses 26 -> 27. Under the as-of rule (G2) record 20 is not late, one timely companion survives, and the count would remain 26.
evidence: prospective_pair/coverage_audit.py:186-194 (served_at built from all official records regardless of lateness)
in-memory coverage_audit.audit() row for 2026-08-03 CHI v PHX T-30m
findings.not_established: The full receipt was NOT recomputed under G2; doing so requires patching coverage_audit.py, outside this node's write scope. Stated as a conditional implication for the owner of D-a.

findings.title: run_pair.cmd's at-most-once guarantee does not hold at the chain level
findings.claim: run_pair.cmd documents that gating makes each (game, decision time) written at most once. Two additional ungated tasks (AM 10:20 ET, PM 18:45 ET) write the same append-only chain, so the guarantee holds only for the gated path.
evidence: prospective_pair/run_pair.cmd (header comment and gated base step)

rules.name: refuse_late
rules.where_it_belongs: the write site of the official chain (daily_forecast.py or a wrapper the scheduled tasks call), NOT the discovery gate
rules.why: schedule-independent: correct no matter which process writes or what invoked it
rules.replay_result: would have REFUSED record 19; would have ALLOWED record 20

rules.name: asof_cutoff
rules.why: lateness must be judged against the tip known at write time; returns None when no capture predates the write rather than silently using the latest tip

shared_contract_changes_proposed: prospective_pair/daily_forecast.py write site (or a wrapper): adopt G1 refuse_late so no base record can be appended at or after its own cutoff. NOT APPLIED.
prospective_pair/coverage_audit.py: adopt G2 as-of cutoff for the late_record classification and separate retroactively-relabelled records from genuinely late ones. NOT APPLIED.
Scheduler: retire or subordinate WNBA_DailyForecast_AM and WNBA_DailyForecast_PM to should_run_base.py. This is a system-configuration change and was NOT made.

escalations.what: The corrected operational-miss figure (27) depends on record 20 being genuinely late. Under the as-of rule it is not, and the figure would remain 26.
